visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of a person's hand pressing a large, blue glowing "START" button on a white console. Above the console, a small rectangular mirror reflects the person holding a smartphone to record. (2) The scene transitions to a large blue screen displaying "Facial Expression" and Japanese text explaining digitalization technology. A small inset shows the person's face covered with a digital tracking mesh. (3) The tracking demo starts, featuring a high-fidelity 3D model of a male character from a video game. As the person in the inset opens their mouth and smiles, the digital character mimics the expressions in real-time. (4) The person navigates a character selection menu, scrolling through various video game icons including Luke, Hunter, and Palico. A loading bar appears on a bright blue background. (5) The demo resumes with a large-scale 3D model of Lady Dimitrescu. The person, seen in a yellow-bordered inset, holds their phone and makes exaggerated expressions—opening their mouth wide, laughing, and sticking out their tongue. The digital character mirrors these movements with high precision. (6) The person moves the camera closer to the screen, focusing on the character's face as it replicates a wide laugh and subtle facial twitches. The background is an indoor exhibition space with high ceilings and bright, even lighting.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a distinctive digital chime as a button is pressed, accompanied by a low room tone. (2) A high-tempo electronic synth melody begins, featuring sharp percussion hits and rhythmic UI clicks as a menu is navigated. (3) The music maintains a constant 125 BPM with no vocal overlays, only occasional digital sound effects mirroring on-screen transitions. (4) A male voice briefly laughs ("Ha-ha-ha-ha") with high arousal and a positive tone, blending into the high-energy BGM. (5) The mix is dominated by the synthetic textures of the music and periodic digital sound effects, while the ambient indoor murmur remains low.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Setup -> Interaction -> Selection -> Deep Demo.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves to showcase advanced real-time facial tracking technology at a Capcom-themed exhibition. It demonstrates the precision of the mapping by showing the user's expressions being instantly replicated by famous game characters like Luke and Lady Dimitrescu, highlighting the immersive potential of the technology.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video highlights a sophisticated digital mirror technology using Capcom IP, combining gaming culture with interactive tech demonstrations.
